alerts.title: Progressive creatinine rise with eGFR 52 on TDF requires urgent review
alerts.message: Guidelines require close renal monitoring in patients on TDF, as renal function can deteriorate with intercurrent illness or dehydration. Patient's creatinine has risen steadily from 0.9 mg/dL (2020) to 1.4 mg/dL (2026), with eGFR now 52 mL/min/1.73m2 and new urinary protein 1+ and glucose trace. Concurrent regular ibuprofen use (2-3 times weekly for 6 months) is a recognised contributor to renal injury and may be compounding TDF-associated nephrotoxicity. Non-drug causes (hypertension is not present, diabetes unlikely given normal BP, but glycosuria warrants evaluation) should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Stop ibuprofen immediately. Repeat creatinine/eGFR, urinalysis and assess for proteinuria; evaluate for TDF-associated renal toxicity and consider switching TDF to a less nephrotoxic NRTI per guideline, with specialist input.
